intro: Pennsylvania runs elections county by county, through the county boards of elections, with the Department of State overseeing the state.

id_rule.text: You do not need photo ID at the polls. If you are voting for the first time in your election district, show an ID. It can be a photo ID or a non-photo ID with your name and address, such as a voter registration card, a current utility bill, a bank statement, or a paycheck. Returning voters do not need ID unless the poll book says so.

dates.label: Last day to apply for a mail-in or absentee ballot
dates.detail: You do not need an excuse. Pennsylvania has no separate early in-person voting period. Before Election Day you can vote a mail ballot in person at your county election office.
